info.name: SIGNL4 and REST Events Webhook API

params.name: teamSecret
params.description: Team or webhook secret that authorizes the alert.

items.docs: Trigger a SIGNL4 mobile alert by posting a payload containing Title and Message fields along with any optional X-S4 control parameters. Authentication is via the team or webhook secret embedded in the URL path. Supports application/json, application/x-www-form-urlencoded, and multipart/form-data content types.
